lemmas.primary_translation: realize how something (unpleasant) really is / see clearly

definitions.translation: realize how something (unpleasant) really is (lit. scales fall from someone's eyes)

examples.no: nå skal skjellene endelig falle fra politikerens øyne

examples.no: skjellene falt fra øyenene mine mens jeg leste
